summary: Phase 2 item 4/4 — CRM Pre-Install Site Survey OFFLINE MOBILE DRAFTS feature: end-to-end Playwright verification of localStorage draft cache, sync-state badges, offline save, restore prompt, reconnect auto-sync and offline upload guard. All 7 behavioural checks pass on the public URL against owner@isodemo.com on AlphaCo (iso-cA) / survey PIS-00001. Reused existing survey to respect the 5-logins/5-min rate limit.

T1_online_dirty_to_synced.notes: Editing field-site_name shows survey-sync-dirty; Save clears local draft, badge flips to survey-sync-synced.

T2_local_persist_pre_save.notes: localStorage key pis_survey_draft_<id> holds {data, savedAt, dirty:true} with edited value immediately after typing (before Save).

T3_offline_save.notes: context.set_offline(True) → survey-sync-offline badge shown. Editing + Save shows toast 'Saved on device — will sync when back online' (📴), no error toast; localStorage keeps dirty:true with the new value.

T4_restore_prompt.notes: Seeded dirty draft in localStorage → reload + reopen editor → survey-restore-banner appears with survey-restore-confirm & survey-restore-discard. Clicking Restore loads the local draft value (verified field-site_name === 'RESTORED_LOCAL_DRAFT').

T5_reconnect_auto_sync.notes: After offline save, set_offline(False)+online event triggers auto-sync: toast 'Reconnected — your draft has been synced' captured via MutationObserver; survey-sync-synced badge shown; localStorage draft cleared; PUT to /api/crm/site-surveys/{id} succeeded (UI reflects new value).

T7_offline_upload_guard.notes: While offline, choosing a file via survey-upload-btn shows toast "You're offline — photos & floor plans upload once you're back online"; no failed network attempt.

critical_code_review_comments: PreInstallSurveys.js is now 731 lines — nearing the 700-line guideline; SurveyEditor (~450 lines including offline logic, AI modal, versions modal, attachments) would benefit from splitting into subcomponents (SurveyEditor, SyncBadge, RestoreBanner, AIAssistModal, VersionsModal) for maintainability.

Auto-sync in goOnline handler only fires when pendingRef.current is true — that flag is set only from a failed save's catch block, so if the user goes offline, edits a field but never taps Save, then reconnects, the local draft stays dirty and will NOT auto-sync until the next explicit Save or reload+Restore. Consider also auto-syncing when dirty && online (with a small debounce) to make the offline UX symmetric.

Restore banner only surfaces when JSON.stringify(localDraft.data) !== JSON.stringify(res.data.data||{}); deep equality via JSON.stringify is order-sensitive and could produce false 'restore' offers if the server serialises keys in a different order. Consider a normalized deep-equal helper.
test_credentials: CRM login: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (5-logins/5-min per-IP rate limit)
seed_data_creation: Reused existing survey PIS-00001 (id 5454d56d-2065-4968-b131-04b026712dcd) on AlphaCo/iso-cA; final DB state: site_name field contains 'ReconnectToastCheck' from the final reconnect test (cleanup not required per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is via the shared /login page (data-testid gx-login-*), NOT /crm/login (that path redirects). After login, navigate to /crm → click 'Companies' sub-tab → data-testid=company-row-iso-cA → click 'Site Surveys' tab (button by role, no testid on the tab bar). Existing survey rows expose data-testid=survey-row-<uuid>. Section-nav save fires save(true) silently and IS what promotes the offline badge on nav changes — do not treat that as a bug. Offline emulation via playwright's page.context.set_offline(True/False) works; ALSO dispatch window offline/online events because the app relies on window listeners (goOnline/goOffline) which are decoupled from playwright's offline flag. MutationObserver on document.body reliably captures react-hot-toast messages which are otherwise gone by the time simple polling runs (~2-4s duration).
